body.p: (task 0.2). tests/test_runner.h and .c, no dependencies. One executable per module, tests/<module>_test.c, holding a static sxml_test_case array passed to sxml_test_run_suite from main; registered as one ctest test named <module> by sxml_add_test(<module>) in tests/CMakeLists.txt. Checks: SXML_TEST_EXPECT (continue) and SXML_TEST_REQUIRE (return from the case). Case names given on the command line run only those cases. Tests may include src/*_internal.h.
